Message: Welcome to EMBER! Meet up with friends, explore community rooms, and try not to break anything within your first five minutes.
Title: Welcome to EMBER

Message: Open the People menu to find, friend, subscribe to, and join other players.
Title: Play together

Message: Use Tokens in the Store to pick up avatar items and customize your look. Financial responsibility is temporarily optional.
Title: Visit the Store

Message: Cheat programs can contain malware, steal passwords, or spy on your computer. Do not trust random downloads made by some guy named xXShadowModderXx.
Title: Stay safe

Message: Never share your password, login token, or account information. EMBER staff will never ask for them.
Title: Protect your account

Message: Create your own room, invite your friends, and build something incredible. Or create an empty cube and call it modern art.
Title: Create something

Message: Save your room regularly. The save button cannot help you after you accidentally delete three hours of work.
Title: Remember to save

Message: Use the Watch menu to change rooms, customize your avatar, manage friends, and stare at menus instead of playing.
Title: Check your Watch

Message: Be respectful to other players. Behind every avatar is a real person, unless Coach has finally become sentient.
Title: Be excellent

Message: Follow EMBER on our socials for updates, announcements, sneak peeks, and occasional posts made at 3 AM with questionable grammar.
Title: Our socials!

Message: Report players who are harassing others, exploiting, or seriously breaking the rules. Do not report someone because they beat you at Paintball.
Title: Use reports responsibly

Message: Experiencing lag? Close unnecessary programs, check your connection, and politely ask your router to lock in.
Title: Performance tip

Message: Your microphone has a mute button. This ancient technology can prevent everyone from hearing your fan, keyboard, dog, and entire household.
Title: Microphone technology

Message: Weekly challenges offer special rewards. Complete them before they disappear into the mysterious weekly challenge dimension.
Title: Weekly challenges

Message: Customize your avatar with outfits, accessories, and colors. Fashion crimes are allowed, but everyone will remember them.
Title: Express yourself

Message: Take photos with the Share Camera and upload your favorite moments. Please verify that your camera is facing the correct direction first.
Title: Capture the moment

Message: If a room fails to load, try joining again. If that does not work, stare at the loading screen aggressively until it becomes intimidated.
Title: Loading problems

Message: Do not download mysterious files from strangers. A file named DefinitelyNotAVirus.exe may contain groundbreaking scientific deception.
Title: Download carefully

Message: EMBER contains approximately zero grams of actual coffee. Side effects may still include staying awake until 4 AM.
Title: EMBER fact

Message: Fun fact: repeatedly pressing a button does not make the server respond faster. It does, however, make you feel involved.
Title: Button science

Message: The orange door is not judging you. Probably.
Title: Important information

Message: Remember to take breaks, drink water, and briefly acknowledge the physical world outside your headset.
Title: Take a break

Message: You are now legally required to have fun. Enforcement remains extremely unclear.
Title: Mandatory fun

Message: Join the EMBER Discord for updates, events, support, and at least three conversations happening in the completely wrong channel. discord.gg/fmcwn23A9c
Title: Join the Discord
